title: Utilization

summary.definition: 가동률은 보유한 설비·용량이 실제 workload를 처리한 정도다.
summary.mechanism: 예약·batching·유휴·장애·수요 변동이 같은 설비의 매출과 비용 흡수율을 바꾼다.
summary.example: GPU를 많이 보유해도 고객 수요가 시간대별로 비어 있으면 감가상각과 전력비 부담이 남는다.
summary.counterScenario: 평균 가동률은 peak·tail latency·고객별 수익성·서비스 품질을 숨길 수 있다.
summary.visualization: 예약·수요 → 실제 사용 → 유휴·장애 → 매출·원가 흡수

formalModelOrRationale.text: 예약·batching·유휴·장애·수요 변동이 같은 설비의 매출과 비용 흡수율을 바꾼다.

inputs: GPU를 많이 보유해도 고객 수요가 시간대별로 비어 있으면 감가상각과 전력비 부담이 남는다.

article.tradingApplication: 가동률을 높이는 것과 높은 가격의 낮은 지연 서비스를 제공하는 것의 trade-off는 무엇인가?

researchEvidence.statement: DOE defines PUE as total facility energy divided by IT-equipment energy. It is a facility-overhead metric, not a complete measure of compute productivity, cost, water use, carbon intensity, or business return.
researchEvidence.invalidation: Measurement boundary, period, load, and site-versus-source energy definitions must match before comparing PUE values.

researchEvidence.statement: NVIDIA's CUDA guide models heterogeneous systems with CPU host code and GPU device code, describes GPUs as highly parallel processors, and exposes matrix, tile, tensor-core, and multi-level memory operations as separate performance mechanisms.
researchEvidence.scope: CPU/GPU division of work, parallel matrix computation, precision, and memory hierarchy
researchEvidence.invalidation: CUDA is an NVIDIA programming and hardware model; it is not a universal description of every GPU, ASIC, NPU, workload, or measured performance result.

researchEvidence.statement: A filed 2025 Form 10-K example separates property-and-equipment capital expenditures in investing cash flow from depreciation recognized after assets are placed in service; capacity investment, accounting expense, and cash generation therefore need separate time and statement-line analysis.
researchEvidence.scope: CAPEX, depreciation, utilization, unit economics, and free-cash-flow interpretation
researchEvidence.invalidation: This is one issuer's filing example and not a universal accounting policy or current forecast; company disclosures, useful lives, capitalization policy, and reporting standards must be checked separately.

researchEvidence.statement: DOE guidance defines PUE as total annual facility energy divided by annual IT-equipment energy and recommends reading it with water, carbon and useful-work or utilization metrics. A lower PUE measures facility overhead, not model quality, accelerator utilization or token economics by itself.
researchEvidence.invalidation: Do not compare sites without matched measurement boundaries, climate, redundancy, workload, time window and IT utilization; a snapshot power ratio is not automatically annual PUE.
